content.comment_body: Hello, I want to reset the 'hour counters' on a [product_name] device by writing a '0' from a ModbusTCP client, but I am unable to locate the correct register addresses. After scanning all Holding Registers, I noticed that addresses between 492 and 500, specifically 495 and 497, appear to be measured in milliseconds, and when these reach their maximum, registers 494 and 496 increase by one. However, these do not seem to be the actual counters, since manually resetting from the [product_name] device does not set these back to zero. Apologies if my explanation is unclear. Thank you.

To reset the operating hours counter on the [product_name] device, you need to send a HIGH signal to the 'RAL' connection. This can be done by sending an output signal from your MODBUS TCP client to the [product_name]. Have you checked the 'Parameter-VM-Mapping' section in the [product_name] software? You can find it under Tools > Parameter-VM-Mapping.
Thank you, I had just found the answer myself and was about to remove my question. I appreciate your help.
Has your question been fully resolved?
